 • by HR Neev Systems
• October 21, 2025November 5, 2025

Experience: 8 + Years

 Job Description

 Key Responsibilities

 • Own the overall ServiceNow architecture — Defining platform strategy, governance standards, and roadmap aligned with business and IT goals.
• Design and implement scalable solutions across multiple ServiceNow modules, including:
 • ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, CMDB)
• CSM (Customer Service Management)
• ITOM (Discovery, Event, Service Mapping, Cloud Management)
• ITAM (Hardware, Software, and Cloud Asset Management)
• SecOps (Security Incident, Vulnerability, Threat Intelligence)
• GRC (Policy, Risk, Audit, and Compliance Management)
• APM (Application Portfolio Management)

• Architect, develop, and optimize Service Portals, Virtual Agent, and Employee Center experiences.
• Lead complex integrations with enterprise systems such as OKTA, Azure AD, Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, JIRA, MS Teams, Active Directory, and monitoring tools via REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and MID Servers.
• Ensure platform performance, scalability, and maintainability through best-practice design and governance.
• Define data models and relationships across CMDB, CSDM, and other configuration elements.
• Enforce security and compliance standards, including ACLs, SSO/MFA setup, and data protection measures.
• Guide and mentor development teams, performing design reviews and code governance.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into architectural blueprints and technical designs.
• Promote automation, orchestration, and AI-driven efficiencies using Flow Designer, Predictive Intelligence, and AI Search.
• Maintain architectural documentation, reusable frameworks, and solution templates for ongoing improvement.
• Stay updated on the latest ServiceNow features and drive continuous innovation within the platform.

 Qualifications

 • 8+ years of experience in ServiceNow design, development, and implementation across multiple modules.
• Proven success in architecting large-scale, enterprise-grade ServiceNow solutions.
• Expertise in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP APIs, CMDB, and CSDM frameworks.
• Hands-on experience with platform integrations (OKTA, Azure AD, JIRA, Teams, SAP, Oracle, etc.).
• Certifications: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD); Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in at least one domain preferred (ITSM, ITOM, SecOps, or GRC).
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

 Nice to Have

 • Experience implementing Virtual Agent, Performance Analytics, Predictive Intelligence, or GenAI capabilities.
• Knowledge of cloud, security, and compliance frameworks (ISO, NIST, SOC2, etc.).
• Background in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, or Agile delivery using JIRA or Azure DevOps.
• Prior experience establishing a ServiceNow Center of Excellence (CoE) or leading multi-instance strategies

About Ellucian

 Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.

 About The Opportunity

 Seeking a highly motivated, team-oriented Senior AI Operations Integration Engineer to build and operationalize secure, reusable integrations and automation that power enterprise AI use cases and adjacent IT workflows. This role focuses on designing and scaling API-based integrations across systems such as Okta/AD, ITSM platforms, M365 admin portals, AWS services, and key AI tools—leveraging cloud-native services, workflow automation platforms, and lightweight services.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience building production-grade integrations with robust authentication, logging, monitoring, and secrets management. They are comfortable creating governed AI consumption layers that safely expose enterprise data and tool actions, and they prioritize scalable integration patterns over one-off solutions. This individual collaborates closely with Data Engineering, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, operationalized solutions, while contributing to architectural decisions and raising the technical bar across the engineering organization.

 Where you will make an impact

 • Build and maintain API-based integrations and lightweight services with strong auth, error handling, retries, logging, and monitoring.
• Create the AI consumption layer: governed tool actions and a lightweight operational data layer (sourced from systems of record like Okta/AD, M365/admin portals, Box, ITSM platforms, etc.) that AI experiences can safely use (channel-agnostic; UX built by partners).
• Use approved automation/orchestration tools; minimize bespoke code and prefer reusable patterns.
• Deliver reusable connector templates/patterns (auth, RBAC, audit logs, telemetry) that can be applied across multiple use cases as needs shift.
• Partner with Data Engineering and other platform teams for long-term hardening; deliver nimble last-mile pipelines and integrations when upstream timelines won’t meet business needs.
• Operationalize what’s built: runbooks, support handoff, access reviews, secrets management, and basic SLOs.
• Communicate clearly with IT and business stakeholders: translate needs into simple integration plans, provide concise status updates, and partner cross-functionally to deliver outcomes without requiring deep technical context from requestors

 What You Will Bring

 • 3-6 years building and operating production integrations/services.
• Strong software engineering skills building and operating API integrations and lightweight services (language-agnostic; Python a plus), including authentication, logging/monitoring, and secure secrets handling.
• Experience with enterprise identity concepts and integrations (Okta; AD familiarity).
• Hands-on experience with SQL-based access patterns (e.g., views, role-based access controls, and consumption-oriented datasets) in any modern data platform.
• Practical AWS experience and security posture (IAM, Secrets Manager, logging/monitoring).
• Practical automation/orchestration experience (Workato or similar iPaaS).

 Good to have

 • Familiarity with MCP-style tool integration patterns (e.g., implementing/operating MCP servers or similar “tool connectors” that expose governed actions and data access to AI assistants).
• Familiarity with ITSM platform integrations (e.g., ServiceNow) and/or M365 admin/usage reporting.

 Key Skills

 • API integration (REST APIs) + OAuth2 / authentication
• Okta (and Active Directory / groups)
• AWS (specifically IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch/monitoring)
• Workato (or “iPaaS”)
• SQL
• RBAC
• MCP servers / tool connectors (or “LLM tool integration,” “function calling,” “AI connectors” as adjacent terms)

 What makes #Ellucianlife

 • 12 days vacation, 10 days causal leaves, 8 days sick leaves plus 11 public holidays
• Competitive gratuity policy
• Group insurance and Annual health checkup plan with a variety of family and wellness benefits.
• Thrive Flex Lifestyle Account (LSA) that allows you to contribute towards your health, financial or learning interests
• 5 charitable days to support the community that supports us
• Wellness
• Headspace (mental health)
• Wellbeats (virtual fitness classes)
• RethinkCare – caregiver support
• Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups such as: Buzzinga and Lean In Team to name a few. 
• Parental leave
• Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
• We Foster a learning culture with:
 • Education Assistance Program
• Professional development opportunities
